message.content: The jaundice started four days ago and has been getting progressively worse since then. Regarding my stools, they are dark, but I wouldn't describe them as black or tarry. I haven't noticed any bleeding. To be honest, I'm not sure about the color of my urine; I haven't really paid attention to that. I've just been feeling very tired and lightheaded over these past four days.
